title: Minor AutoFirma differences (CAdES contentHint,
notes: MIME sniffing, NULL digest parameters) left as they are.
result: Checked offline instead of changing live-verified signature output: AutoFirma 1.9's own validator (autofirma.jar verify) reports 'Firma valida' for synthetic CAdES implicit and explicit, XAdES enveloped and enveloping over XML, XAdES enveloping and internally detached over plain text (MimeType application/octet-stream), and PAdES; tampered copies of the CAdES, XAdES and PAdES are reported 'Firma no valida'. No code changed.
resolution: No validator objects, which was this item's only trigger; the one external validator not yet tried, valide.redsara.es, stays tracked under 'FACe and valide.redsara.es never tried', which now names these three differences as the first suspects if it objects.
